on_screen: "Chatbot" and "Agent" side by side, a question mark between them
text: Your chatbot answers. Why can't it act?

on_screen: a student's project board with "Build an AI agent" pinned at the top
text: If you are building AI projects, this difference decides what you actually build next.

on_screen: definition card - "What is a chatbot?", source: IBM
text: A chatbot is a software application that communicates with people through text or voice. [C2]

props.headline: What is a chatbot?
props.label: DEFINITION
props.definition: A chatbot is a software application that communicates with people through text or voice.

on_screen: a chat bubble asking "When is my exam?" and a single reply
text: Ask it when your exam is, and it answers, then waits for your next message.

on_screen: definition card - "What are AI agents?", source: IBM
text: An agent is different: a system that autonomously performs tasks by designing workflows with available tools. [C3]

props.headline: What are AI agents?
props.label: DEFINITION
props.definition: An AI agent is a system that autonomously performs tasks by designing workflows with available tools.

on_screen: illustrative flow, labelled "example": search, read, shortlist, calendar
text: Give it a goal like "shortlist internships that match my résumé and add the deadlines to my calendar", and it plans the steps, searches, reads, shortlists and writes the entries itself.

on_screen: quote card, source: Anthropic, "Building effective agents"
text: Anthropic describes agents as systems where the model directs its own process and tool use. [C1]

props.headline: Building effective agents
props.label: QUOTE
props.definition: “Agents, on the other hand, are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, maintaining control over how they accomplish tasks.”

on_screen: two-line checklist - "Only talks: chatbot" / "Pursues a goal, uses tools, acts: agent"
text: So here is the test. If it only talks, it is a chatbot. If it pursues a goal and completes tasks for you, it is an agent. [C4]

props.headline: Only talks: chatbot
items: Pursues a goal, uses tools, acts: agent
